evidence: A separate fresh context reviewed all digest inputs, the merged identity boundaries, migrations, effective privileges, dependency advisories and execution evidence; no stopping findings remained.

The reviewer ran 72 non-database boundary and digest tests successfully. Supplied evidence showed 293 application tests, 44 storage integration tests, the production build and one browser test passing.

Real stub-provider sessions exercised both storage adapters and queued test effects. Viewer and unassigned role changes restricted the next attempt; production jobs retained their fixed system identity.
All 22 planted privilege faults were detected. Both baseline and restored permission suites passed 26 tests; the row-policy fault was also detected and restored.
The sign-in change restricts session identities to user roles after system jobs introduced the system role. The review digest also covers the user-role definitions.

The jobs configuration documentation was corrected to include the website sign-in settings. The advisory review found only tooling paths; flagged CLI dependencies remain present but unused in the production image.
limits: No real company directory registration, SMTP delivery or hosted storage permissions were exercised.
User-authorised queued handlers are integration examples; the production worker exposes only fixed system tasks and no user-job submission endpoint.
The reviewer reran non-database tests and read supplied execution logs for the other checks.
The digest verifies content correspondence, not reviewer identity; GitHub review independence is unverified.
